parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Listening
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Choose the correct answer (a, b or c).

parts.title: Part 3 · Gap fill
parts.instr: Write ONE word in each gap.

items.q: Our plane ____ off at 10:45 a.m., and we landed in Rome at 1:50 p.m.
It’s not Tim’s ____ the window’s broken, Dad. We were playing, and I pushed him.
I’ve never ____ Francesca any money because I’ve heard from other people that she never returns it.
Artur: “I know. It’s ____ down out there! Horrible!”
Three prisoners have already ____ from the prison since the start of the year.
What would you buy if I ____ you £10,000?
My sister and brother aren’t close; they have very little ____ common.
You don’t need to drive this fast, Anna. We’ve got ____ time to get to the airport.
I’m sorry to ____ you waiting. I’ll be with you in a minute.
Many soldiers ____ killed during the war, and nobody can do anything to stop it.
He said his laptop was faulty but, ____ my opinion, there’s nothing wrong with it.
I think Michela lives ____ pasta. I never see her eat anything else!
Let me ____ that bag for you. I’m very strong!
Would you mind ____ the shopping tomorrow instead of today?
____ she had plenty of opportunities, Deborah never visited any foreign countries.

parts.title: Part 5 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word. Type the whole corrected sentence.

items.text: Both these paints are white, but please don’t mixture them together. I bought this one especially for painting the bathroom.
I don’t know whether I should go to the police. What would you do if you were at my situation?
All the snacks we eat in my family are made for my mother. They aren’t very tasty, but we never tell her; she loves making them.
Sam and I enjoyed us very much at the zoo, Aunt Margaret. Thank you for taking us.
I didn’t think you ever wore that old pullover, so I throwed it away when I was cleaning the house last weekend.
We can use the expression “If I were you” to make advice.
Jonny, you need to drink less beer, do some exercise, and put better care of your health generally.
You should avoid to worry about what happened if you can. You’re not going to lose your job.
Just yesterday, fourteen babies born in this hospital. It’s a real pleasure to work here.
I have no influence for Rory, I’m afraid. He just does what he wants.

parts.text: We put ham, cheese and egg in sandwiches. The three forms of “run” are “run, ran, run”. The opposite of “keep a promise” is “break a promise”. A rain shower is a short period of rain. A mirror reflects light. If there’s no rain, grass becomes yellow and then it dies. The past of “throw” is “threw”. A hundred centimetres make a metre. Mice like eating cheese. We find sand on a beach or in a desert. A wall is normally built of bricks. Twelve inches make a foot. Red and blue can be mixed to make purple. We get wool from a sheep.

teacher.2: What does the verb “give back” mean?
teacher.3: What do we use wire for?
teacher.5: How many letters is the English alphabet composed of?
teacher.7: What are the three forms of “lie”?
teacher.8: What do footballers’ shirts have written on their backs?
teacher.9: What do we sometimes see and hear in a storm?

1: Both these paints are white, but please don’t mix them together. I bought this one especially for painting the bathroom.
2: I don’t know whether I should go to the police. What would you do if you were in my situation?
3: All the snacks we eat in my family are made by my mother. They aren’t very tasty, but we never tell her; she loves making them.
4: Sam and I enjoyed ourselves very much at the zoo, Aunt Margaret. Thank you for taking us.
5: I didn’t think you ever wore that old pullover, so I threw it away when I was cleaning the house last weekend.
6: We can use the expression “If I were you” to give advice.
7: Jonny, you need to drink less beer, do some exercise, and take better care of your health generally.
8: You should avoid worrying about what happened if you can. You’re not going to lose your job.
9: Just yesterday, fourteen babies were born in this hospital. It’s a real pleasure to work here.
10: I have no influence over Rory, I’m afraid. He just does what he wants.
